description:
List, open, select or close tabs in this browser window.

Open a tab to begin a separate piece of work or to keep a page you need to come back to later. Otherwise, stay in the tab you are in: click a link to follow it, or navigate to a URL. When a link needs its own tab, give its tab and ref in place of a URL. Leave out the URL for a blank tab. Use the tab IDs the tool returns. All tabs share the window's browsing profile. Close tabs you no longer need to keep the window tidy. Closing a tab does not undo anything already done in it.

image.description: Inspect one image region, optionally with proposed outlines and numbered points. The unchanged source and one inspection view are attached. This edits a copy; it does not zoom or change the page.

source.description: Omit for a fresh screenshot without annotations. Supply exactly one form: {screenshot} for a saved i… reference; {receipt, program, frame} for a retained program capture; or {result, images} for saved attachments. Supply every field in the chosen form and none from another. The attachment batch form takes no crop, scale or annotations.

screenshot.description: Saved screenshot reference, such as i12. Use this field alone.

result.description: Saved result ID printed in image delivery feedback.

images.description: Exact image numbers to fetch from that saved result. No browser action or image processing is repeated.

crop.description: Rectangle in full screenshot pixels. Omit to use the full screenshot. Edges outside the screenshot are clipped.

scale.description: Requested display scale, such as 2 to double the crop. The result reports its actual size after normal image delivery limits. Omit for original size.

annotations.description: Proposed interpretations in the source's original pixel coordinates. Each group has a colored outline and globally numbered points. The tool counts the supplied points; it does not verify object detection. Non-empty annotations require source: a screenshot reference or retained program frame.

outline.description: Outline vertices; three or more close the polygon.

ref.description: An element reference from the current view.
